drivingQuestion: Is the mishna's permission to tie wine and oil skins superfluous?
outcomeNote: the clause is needed for a two-opening skin

segments.he: וְנוֹדוֹת יַיִן וָשֶׁמֶן. פְּשִׁיטָא! לָא צְרִיכָא, דְּאִית לֵיהּ תַּרְתֵּי אוּנֵּי, מַהוּ דְתֵימָא: חֲדָא מִינַּיְיהוּ בַּטּוֹלֵי מְבַטֵּל לַהּ, קָא מַשְׁמַע לַן.
segments.en: «And» we learned in the mishna: It is permitted to tie the spouts of «wine or oil jugs.» The Gemara says: This is «obvious.» The Gemara explains: It is «only necessary» to teach this halakha in a case «where it,» the jug, «has two ears,» i.e., two spouts. «Lest you say: One of them, he voids it consequently defining» the knot on that opening permanent and therefore prohibited, «it teaches us» that this is not the case.
